reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Net earnings limitation and deductible operating cost computation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(3): caps life insurance company urban redevelopment net earnings at 8% per annum of project cost (or amortized balance) after deducting operating costs, taxes/insurance, and <=60-year amortization.

headings.title: Surplus earnings reserve, amortization acceleration, and municipal turnover
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: development plan may allow surplus earnings reserve for return maintenance, prior deficiency offsets, accelerated amortization, project enlargement, or rent reduction, with remaining surplus turned over to city when § 353.110 tax relief ends.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 353.040 (bid 18987), both subsections with subdivisions (1)-(3), and history notes (L. 1945, A.L. 1947). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Initial ten-year ad valorem tax abatement based on land-only assessment
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: up to 10-year exemption from ad valorem taxes except land-only pre-acquisition assessed valuation, frozen during compliance with authorized development plan except per sub 4.

headings.title: Subsequent fifteen-year partial tax exemption and adjacent land assessment
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: adjacent-land assessment for previously tax-exempt land, up to 15-year 50%-of-true-value assessment cap, and full taxation after 25 years (or earlier election) free of chapter 353 limits.

headings.title: Prerequisites for tax abatement: impact statement, public hearing, and ordinance
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3(1)-(3): abatement requires written tax-impact statement and notice to affected political subdivisions, public hearing, and ordinance setting expiration of development/eminent-domain/abatement rights if property not acquired.

headings.title: Payments in lieu of taxes and emergency services district reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4(1)-(2) and original-rolls footnote (*'chapter' before 321): contractual PILOTs allocated pro rata, and beginning Aug. 28, 2018, 50%–100% reimbursement to chapters 190/321 emergency-services districts/counties with annual rate-setting and recalculation on plan amendment.

headings.title: Grandfather exemption for pre-existing phased development plans
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: sub 3 does not apply to amendments to phased development plans approved before sub 3's effective date with construction in progress.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 353.110 (bid 35959), all five subsections with subdivisions, history notes (L. 1945 through A.L. 2018 S.B. 870), and original-rolls footnote (*Word 'chapter' appears here in original rolls in sub 4(2)(b)). Retained all five titles.

headings.title: Corporate authority to acquire real property or options
headings.reviewNote: Refined title to match text. Verified sub 1: urban redevelopment corporation may acquire real property or options in its own name or nominees' names by gift, grant, lease, purchase, or otherwise.

headings.title: Eminent domain authority for pre-2007 agreements
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to include Dec. 31, 2006 agreement cutoff. Verified sub 2: eminent domain right applies to redevelopment agreements executed on or before Dec. 31, 2006, only when empowered by municipal legislative authority.

headings.title: Condemnation procedure under chapter 523 and public property consent
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: chapter 523 or other statutory condemnation procedure for agreements executed on or before Dec. 31, 2006; public-use property of city, county, state, or political subdivision cannot be taken without its consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 353.130 (bid 18996), all three subsections, and history notes (L. 1943, A.L. 1945, A.L. 2006 H.B. 1944). Revised sub 1 title (gift/grant/lease/purchase/options) and sub 2 title to preserve the critical Dec. 31, 2006 redevelopment-agreement cutoff.

headings.title: Borrowing authority and mortgage lien limits to single development area
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: urban redevelopment corporation may borrow funds secured by an amortizing mortgage limited to real property within a single development area.

headings.title: First mortgage securities as legal investments for fiduciaries and financial institutions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2(1)-(5): first-mortgage certificates, bonds, and notes are legal investments for fiduciaries, banking/insurance entities, and state finance/DCI directors acting as conservators/liquidators.

headings.title: Subordinate and junior mortgage liens permitted
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: mortgage on development-area real property may create a first, second, or other junior lien.

headings.title: Property disposition upon foreclosure and tax relief eligibility for purchasers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: allows property sale/disposition; city 'may' grant continuing § 353.110 tax relief to foreclosure/voluntary purchasers following the plan without imposing earnings caps on non-redevelopment/non-life-insurer purchasers.

headings.title: Invalidation of earnings limits on non-redevelopment corporation purchasers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: voids any earnings limitation on non-redevelopment-corporation / non-life-insurer purchasers under any existing or future plan or contract.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 353.150 (bid 18998), all five subsections with subdivisions (1)-(5), and history notes (L. 1943, A.L. 1945, A.L. 2008 H.B. 2058). Retained all five titles.
